pages.text: The $(item)Vanguard Point$() is a notice board where you call new mercenaries to your base.

$(thing)Right-click$() it, put $(item)20 Gold Coins$() in the slot and press $(thing)Post Request$(). Only the player who deposited the coins can use or take them back, and any extra coins are returned.$(br2)A company starts marching and arrives in $(thing)7 in-game days$(). Sleeping through the night counts too.

pages.title: Arrival
pages.text: Fireworks and horns announce the arrival. A new $(thing)Berserker, Guardian or Duelist$() appears next to the Vanguard Point.$(br2)The 20 coins only pay for the march. To keep the mercenary, you still need to $(l:epicvanguard:getting_started/recruiting)hire them$() normally.$(br2)The march only advances while its chunk is loaded.
